definitions.explanation: Steady and constant progress or development; advancing day by day and month by month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{科学技術|かがくぎじゅつ}→科学技術：20794_kagakugijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Science and technology are advancing rapidly.

examples.japanese: ⟦AI→AI：07764_eeai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The field of AI is making rapid progress.

examples.japanese: {日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れない→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to keep up in this age of rapid progress.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧):
{日進|にっしん} (daily progress) + {月歩|げっぽ} (monthly advance)

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧: day, sun
- {進|しん}: advance, progress
- {月|げつ}: month, moon
- ⟦{歩|ほ}→〜歩：00108_ho⟧: step, walk
"Advancing day by day, progressing month by month" - emphasizing continuous improvement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (rapidly advancing technology)
- {日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発展|はってん}する→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧ (to develop rapidly)
- {日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世|よ}の{中|なか}→世の中：03666_yononaka⟧ (a rapidly changing world)

USAGE:
Commonly used when discussing technological development, medical advances, or any field experiencing rapid change.
